description: A workplace relations partner must redesign a recurring cross-team handoff huddle that has become tense and unproductive. The binding decision must set the meeting format, facilitator, accessibility safeguards, documentation responsibility, pilot length, and review process.

shared_context.S1: The cross-team handoff huddle meets twice each week to coordinate work between the product and support groups.
shared_context.S2: Several participants have reported that the huddle has become tense, with people talking over one another and leaving unclear about next steps.
shared_context.S3: Leah has authority to replace the current huddle format and issue a temporary operating plan.
shared_context.S4: The department's normal decision routine is for each affected participant to give a brief statement about workable changes before the chair closes the plan.

PF1.text: Noor has led exactly three difficult cross-team reset meetings in the past year, and each produced a written agreement on next steps. She is available to facilitate this huddle pilot, and these examples are in her personal notes but were not included in the huddle materials.

PF2.text: Inez has an approved arrangement requiring recurring meetings to begin no earlier than 10:00 and agendas to be distributed at least 24 hours beforehand; the arrangement is recorded with her manager but has not been added to this huddle's calendar.

PF3.text: Omar agreed with the outgoing project lead that he would remain the note-taker for the first 28-day trial and publish the huddle notes within one business day; the outgoing lead's email confirming this has not reached Leah.

PF4.text: Tessa confirmed this week that a temporary interpersonal meeting pilot must last exactly 28 days, include a midpoint review on day 14, and collect an anonymous pulse survey at the end; this guidance has not yet been added to the operating draft.

acceptance_conditions: Noor must be appointed facilitator and exactly three documented reset examples must be recorded.
The huddle must begin at 10:00 or later and agendas must be distributed at least 24 hours in advance.
Omar must be assigned as note-taker with notes published within one business day.
The temporary pilot must last exactly 28 days with a midpoint review on day 14.
An anonymous pulse survey must be required at the end of the pilot.
The settlement must include commitments to carry out the note-taking and midpoint-review arrangements.

content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Omar' and 'one business day' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any('midpoint review' in c['detail'] and ('day 14' in c['detail'] or 'day-14' in c['detail'] or 'day fourteen' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Noor's three documented reset examples and availability change the facilitator choice to Noor and change the evidence count to exactly 3.
Inez's approved arrangement changes the meeting start requirement to at least 10:00 and the agenda notice requirement to at least 24 hours.
Omar's prior agreement changes the documentation assignment to Omar with the exact requirement to publish notes within one business day.
The confirmed pilot guidance changes the duration to exactly 28 days, fixes the midpoint review at day 14, requires the anonymous survey, and creates the midpoint-review commitment.
